LESSON: VIRTUES IN ISLAM • TRUTHFULNESS • FORGIVENESS

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Akhlaq (Moral Teachings)
Topic 5.2: Virtues in Islam • truthfulness • forgiveness
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 5

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Virtues in Islam • truthfulness • forgiveness, part of Akhlaq (Moral Teachings) in Grade 7 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION.

Key inquiry question: Why should a Muslim be truthful? 2. Why is it important for a Muslim to exercise forgiveness?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. discuss the Islamic teachings on truthfulness and forgiveness and make class presentations,

2. discuss the significance of upholding truthfulness and make notes,

3. research individually on the significance of forgiveness and make notes,

4. record short videos as they dramatise acts depicting truthfulness and forgiveness in society and share on social media platforms. 1.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. discuss the Islamic teachings on truthfulness and forgiveness and make class presentations,
2. discuss the significance of upholding truthfulness and make notes,
3. research individually on the significance of forgiveness and make notes,
4. record short videos as they dramatise acts depicting truthfulness and forgiveness in society and share on social media platforms. 1.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Virtues in Islam • truthfulness • forgiveness together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Creativity and Imagination: the skill of making connections is enhanced as the learners record short videos as they dramatise

acts depicting truthfulness and forgiveness in society and share on social media platforms

• Communication and Collaboration: the learners listen, appreciate and respect the opinion of others when discussing in

groups Islamic teachings on truthfulness and forgiveness.

• Digital Literacy Skills: the learners interact with digital technology as they record short videos and share on social media

platforms.

Values:
• Integrity: enhanced as learners discuss in groups the significance of upholding truthfulness.

• Peace: learners discuss the Islamic teachings on truthfulness and forgiveness.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

• Integrity: enhanced as learners discuss in groups the significance of upholding truthfulness.

• Social Cohesion: enhanced as learners discuss the Islamic teachings on truthfulness and forgiveness.
